OLIVER.bio: OLIVER is the electronic production duo of Vaughn Oliver and Oliver Goldstein. Northern Dial carries the duo's 2017 track 'Go With It' from the album Full Circle. Vaughn Oliver is a Canadian producer originally associated with Vancouver, and the duo's catalogue blends electro, nu-disco and pop production. Northern Dial retains OLIVER in its Canadian catalogue based on Vaughn Oliver's Canadian identity and the exact Full Circle recording credit.

Carmen.bio: Carmen is Carmen Thomas, one half of the Canadian twin-sister pop duo Carmen & Camille. Northern Dial carries Carmen through 'Shine 4U' and 'Shine 4U 2.0,' recordings tied directly to Carmen & Camille's Juno-nominated Canadian catalogue. The sisters were raised in White Rock, British Columbia and built their early career in Vancouver before expanding internationally.

Camille.bio: Camille is Camille Thomas, one half of the Canadian twin-sister pop duo Carmen & Camille. Northern Dial's Camille entry is tied to 'Shine 4U' and 'Shine 4U 2.0,' recordings credited to the duo and their remix collaborators. Carmen & Camille emerged from Vancouver and their single 'Shine 4U' earned a Juno nomination for Dance Recording of the Year.

Manchi.bio: Manchi is a Toronto hip-hop artist associated with the early-2000s Ghetto Concept orbit. Northern Dial carries Manchi on Ghetto Concept's 2002 single 'Westend Story' alongside J-Wyze, Ray Smoove, Madlocks, DJ G-Starr and Black-I. Contemporary and retrospective Toronto hip-hop references place Manchi within the same local scene around Ghetto Concept and Infinite.

Mic Check.bio: Mic Check is an Ottawa-based French-language rapper who appeared with DL Incognito on 'Savoir Faire' from the 2002 album A Sample and a Drum Machine and later on 'Fall Back.' Northern Dial's Mic Check entry is tied directly to that DL Incognito catalogue, and artist profiles identify Mic Check as representing Ottawa, Canada.
